answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds. Consider a tundra as the anchor of the cost.
